reason: The controller died after the card. The external stop left about 7 minutes of trailing dead air; the standard batch job preserved four valid prefix windows, then refused on a silent window. Recover only the card-bearing interval without re-running a failed arm.

system.selection_basis: Already-completed, untruncated production batch result covering the operator-reported card.

microphone.selection_basis: Frozen from 10-second PCM RMS telemetry before ASR: speech rises above the room-noise floor in these four groups.

mixed.selection_basis: Frozen production-style 150-second windows spanning the card and excluding trailing dead air.
